snippet.description:

Lyrics

New York City’s never looked so blue
My friends are smoking blunts in the bathroom
They say that honest love
Is a cage that makes you feel free
And all the girls at this party are so cool
That’s never been a thing that I could do
But I can’t help but imagine
What you say when you speak with me

You’re a spark in the dark
And my clothes all caught aflame
You should feel how I feel
When somebody says your name
I’m a car speeding down
The boulevard without a brake
And I want you more than
Any stupid song could ever say
I’m a heart made of wax
And I’m melting in the sun
I’m a thread on your shirt
That is coming undone
I feel right, I feel wrong
I feel totally insane
And I want you more than
Any stupid song could ever say

Walking through the park with my head high
Past all the college girls and the drunk guys
And if there is a God
He’s the bond that’s between us two
Seven nights alone and a skipped meal
I’m sleeping in my dress and my high heels
And I’m too shy to say what I see
When I dream of you
When I dream of you

You’re a spark in the dark
And my clothes all caught aflame
You should feel how I feel
When somebody says your name
I’m a car speeding down
The boulevard without a brake
And I want you more than
Any stupid song could ever say

And I’m melting in the sun
I’m a thread on your shirt
That is coming undone
I feel right, I feel wrong
I feel totally insane
And I want you more than
Any stupid song could ever say

Every night like the one before
Dream of you from like 1 to 4
Positively and truly sure
Nobody’s wanted somebody more
It’s a thing that I can’t ignore
Tell your friends that you’re mine
I’m yours
With the hand on my heart I swore

snippet.title: ICE CITY | EPISODE 2
snippet.description:
ICE CITY | Official Trailer

Set against the backdrop of modern London culture, Ice City explores friendship, pressure, street politics, family, and the choices people make when they are trying to rise above their circumstances.

What starts as ambition soon becomes a test of loyalty, as each character is forced to decide who they really are, who they can trust, and how far they are willing to go.

Raw, stylish, and character-driven, Ice City captures the energy of London youth culture through sharp dialogue, music, fashion, humour, and tension. It is not just about conflict, but about identity, brotherhood, legacy, and the cost of chasing power in a city that does not give second chances.

Subscribe to the channel and turn on notifications so you do not miss the release.

ICE CITY SOUNDTRACK out on DSPs now https://ditto.fm/ice-city-soundtrack-ice-city

snippet.title: Gatto | Teaser Trailer | In Theaters March 5, 2027
snippet.description:
Ciao Gatto
Watch the new teaser for Disney & Pixar's #Gatto, arriving in theaters March 5, 2027

Mark Ruffalo (“Poor Things,” “The Avengers,” “Spotlight, “Foxcatcher”) has joined the voice cast as the scrappy black cat Nero, and Laurence Fishburne (“The Matrix” trilogy, “Boyz n the Hood,” “What's Love Got to Do with It”) will voice the ruthless mob boss cat Rocco. The teaser trailer introduces Nero and Rocco as they question another cat in a funny interrogation scene.
In “Gatto,” after years of maneuvering the canal-ridden, superstitious city of Venice, Italy, Nero begins to question whether he’s lived the right lives. Indebted to Rocco, the local feline mob boss, Nero finds himself in a quandary and is forced to forge a truly unexpected friendship that may finally lead him to his purpose—unless Venice gets the better of him first.
“Gatto” is directed by Enrico Casarosa and produced by Andrea Warren, the filmmaking team behind the Oscar®-nominated feature “Luca.” The new film releases exclusively in theaters March 5, 2027.

ABOUT PIXAR ANIMATION STUDIOS
Pixar Animation Studios, a wholly owned subsidiary of The Walt Disney Company, is an Academy Award®-winning film studio with world-renowned technical, creative and production capabilities in the art of computer animation. The Northern California studio has created some of the most successful and beloved animated films of all time, including “Toy Story,” “Monsters, Inc.,” “Cars,” “The Incredibles,” “Ratatouille,” “WALL•E,” “Up,” “Brave,” “Inside Out,” “Coco,” “Soul,” “Turning Red,” “Elemental,” and “Inside Out 2.”

snippet.title: The Cranberries - Scenes From 'Linger' (The Only Color Reel)
snippet.description:
Scenes from 'Linger' / (The Only Color Reel) by The Cranberries

Directed by Melodie McDaniel in 1993, "Linger" was filmed almost entirely on 16mm black-and-white film, a deliberate aesthetic choice inspired by Jean-Luc Godard's 1965 noir film Alphaville. But one reel was shot in color. A brief moment from it appeared in the original music video, desaturated and lasting under 15 seconds. This is the full scene from that reel: every take, in color, restored from the original 16mm and presented in 4K for the first time.

Designed to give fans a deeper connection to the band's legacy, the "Scenes From" series strips away the traditional music video edit to present raw, 4K performance takes restored from the original film sources.

snippet.title: Paul Heaton - Favourite Kind Of Idiot (Official Video) ft. Rianne Downey
snippet.description:
#PaulHeaton #FavouriteKindofIdiot #Jenius

Pre-order the new album ‘JENIUS’ now: https://PaulHeaton.lnk.to/Jenius 
Listen to ‘Favourite Kind of Idiot’ now: https://PaulHeaton.lnk.to/FKOI 
Tickets to the UK Tour onsite now: https://lnk.to/PaulHeaton2026 

Follow Paul Heaton:
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/paulheatonofficial /paulheatonofficial 
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@paulheatonofficial / paulheatonofficial 
Twitter: https://x.com/PaulHeatonSolo?lang=en / paulheatonsolo 
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/paulheatonofficial /paulheatonofficial
Website: https://www.paulheaton.co.uk/
Sign up for updates: https://PaulHeaton.lnk.to/signupsocials

Directed by Andy Hylton

Lyrics

I saw you tie your shoe laces
You looked so very pleased
They came undone immediately
You sank down on your knees

Later at the light bulb change
It took you several hours
I watched you punch the air in joy
I thought the future’s ours

North Korea on holiday
Beirut for a midweek break
We could go just anywhere
And make the most of our mistake

And if the sun don’t shine
Well the boy’s still mine
Like a right foot in left shoe
My favourite kind of idiot
Is you, you, you
You’re a little bit cute
But you ain’t no beaut
But I don’t date you for the view
My favourite kind of idiot is you

I saw you try to cross the road
In a fight that you still lose
Both cycle lane and bus lane
Still leaving you confused

Returning half hour later
You still looked pretty lost
Finally reached the other side
But forgotten why you’d crossed

New York, London, Milan, Paris
None of them we’ve been
Just a one day trip to the council tip
Fulfils our every dream

I can’t believe the things we do
When just left on our own
But madness and insanity
Furnished both our homes
You’re my dream idiot
I hope I’m your dream fool
Nevermind the law
Or security door
If you weren’t meant to break the rules

#PaulHeaton #FavouriteKindofIdiot #Jenius

snippet.description:
If Aarzu found a place in your heart, Asim Azhar's rendition takes it even deeper. Wrapped in dreamy melodies and timeless emotion, this version captures the beauty of yearning for someone who never truly leaves.


Listen Now:
Spotify - https://open.spotify.com/track/1GnZH0wek1fkGCQnUsK6D0?si=c8a640db631c4690 Apple Music -  https://music.apple.com/in/song/aarzu-with-asim-azhar/6772998267

Producer - Syed Jahanzaib Ali
Executive Producer - Gul-E-Rana

Lyrics:

(Khan)

Tera sharmana meri jaana kabhi
Rakhlu chupaake teri yaadein sabh
Khwaabon main mere hai tu hi basi

Tera sharmana meri jaana kabhi
Rakhlu chupaake teri yaadein sabh
Khwaabon main mere hai tu hi basi

(Madhurxo)

Peeche dekhu raahein teri yaadein jo rahi na meri
Khwaabon main basa hai tu hi tu.
Sawalon main main rakhlu chupake mujhe tu hi toh bigaade
Meri aankhon main saja hai tu hi tu

Peeche dekhu raahein teri yaadein jo rahi na meri
Khwaabon main basa hai tu hi tu.
Sawalon main main rakhlu chupake mujhe tu hi toh bigaade
Meri aankhon main saja hai tu hi tu

(Asim Azhar)

Oh kaisi dilkashi 
Tujh se dillagi
Mere humnasheen… hmmmm
Kioun chupaoun main
Ab koi darr nahi
Tu jaisay meri pari
Masoomiyut chulkay teri
Baatoun se kitni…hayee
Saada si jo adaa’ein teri
Qatil hai woh
Dil ki meri

Peechay dekhoun raahein teri
Yaadein jo rahi na meri
Khwaboun mein basa hai tu hi tu
Sawaaloun mein bhi rakh loun chupa ke
Mujhe tu hi tou bigaray
Meri ankhoun mein saja hai ti hi tu

(Unknown)

Phirse Bolo

(Asim Azhar)

Peechay dekho raahein teri
Yaad jo rahi na meri
Khwaboun mein basa hai tu hi tu
Sawaaloun mein bhi rakh loun chupa ke
Mujhe tu hi tou bigaray
Meri ankhoun mein saja hai ti hi tu

Tera sharmana, meri jaana kabhi
Rakh loun chupa ke teri yaadein sab hi
Khwaboun mein mere hai tu hi basi
Tu hi basi… tu hi basi

(Khan and Asim)

Tera sharmana, meri jaana kabhi
Rakh loun chupa ke teri yaadein sab hi
Khwaboun mein mere hai tu hi basi
Tu hi basi… tu hi basi

(Outro)

Dono jahan teri muhabbat mein haar ke
Woh ja raha hai koi Shab’e Ghum guzaar ke
Weera’an hai maikada khum-o-saagar udaas hain     
Tum kya gaye k rooth gaye din bahaar

snippet.description:
A powerful Nordic rap / Viking hip-hop music video about inner pressure, survival, unity, and finding strength when everything feels like it is falling apart.

The summer game fest happened the other day or as everyone still calls it E3. At not E3 E3, they showed off lots of new games. snippet.title: XIT KODDI (Official Music Video) - Black Sapphire | Alison Gonsalves | Konkani Song 2026
snippet.description:
Xit Koddi – An Original Konkani Song by Alison Gonsalves & Black Sapphire
Our staple food deserved a song, so we made one.
An ode to Goa’s beloved staple meal, Xit Koddi (Goan fish curry rice), and the emotion every Goan connects with, no matter where they are in the world. 

Xit Koddi is also commonly written as Xit Kodi, Xitt Kodi, Xitt Koddi, Xit Codi, Xitt Khodi, Shit Kodi, Rice Curry, and Goan Fish Curry Rice.

From traditional Goan kitchens and paddy fields to friends sharing a simple meal, Xit Koddi reflects the warmth, friendship, unity, and togetherness that have always been part of Goa’s culture.

localized.description:
Xit Koddi – An Original Konkani Song by Alison Gonsalves & Black Sapphire
Our staple food deserved a song, so we made one.
An ode to Goa’s beloved staple meal, Xit Koddi (Goan fish curry rice), and the emotion every Goan connects with, no matter where they are in the world. 

Xit Koddi is also commonly written as Xit Kodi, Xitt Kodi, Xitt Koddi, Xit Codi, Xitt Khodi, Shit Kodi, Rice Curry, and Goan Fish Curry Rice.

From traditional Goan kitchens and paddy fields to friends sharing a simple meal, Xit Koddi reflects the warmth, friendship, unity, and togetherness that have always been part of Goa’s culture.

snippet.description:
From June 6th to June 21st, the world’s top VALORANT teams will battle at Masters London, the second global event of the 2026 VALORANT Champions Tour. Twelve teams qualified through Stage 1 tournaments of their respective regional leagues, will compete for Championship Points and a chance to advance toward Champions Shanghai.

We’re proud to work with our fantastic partners throughout 2026: AWS, Coinbase, EWC, ENC, Globant, HyperX, Mastercard, OMEN, Red Bull, Secretlab, and Verizon.

snippet.title: We Just Completely BROKE Hunters.. Enjoy it! [Destiny 2 Hunter Build]
snippet.description:
YOUTUBE MEMBER:
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCIyCSH_pqV_wOzVYm8s9Hkw/join

We Just Completely BROKE Hunters.. Enjoy! [Destiny 2 Hunter Build]

DISCORD: https://discord.gg/HmFvvKD
TWITTER: https://twitter.com/plunderthabooty
TWITCH: https://www.twitch.tv/plunderthabooty

https://dim.gg/mnpcp7y/1-Solar-Hunter-Build-Crackshot

I think we did it guys, we completely Broke the sandbox for the finally of Destiny 2.  

I don't even know where to begin with this! Keep in mind that I am on a Solar Hunter which arguably is suppose to have some of the worst survivability in hard content. Also I wasn't even using an Exotic weapon. I should have had on Anarchy or Dragons breath for even more destruction. The gameplay truly speaks for itself. My health bar up top hardly ever moves. Just watch it.

I jump head first into multiple champions, a ton of enemies. Even mini bosses and straight up bosses at the end of runs.

All Gameplay is from Ultimate difficulty where we are locked 30 power level under. 

I bet you never thought a Hunter could run around with Infinite Restoration, Cure, Woven Mail, Amplified and Overshields.

Well we can now..  By combining these Buffs we can run head first into anything and not give a care in the world about what's Infront of us. I have never felt as unkillable as this..

And that's Just on the Survivability Side.

But What about the Offensive side. Your seeing solar Ignitions going off, Arc Bolt charge lightning being called down. The Arc Jolt debuff zapping enemies left and right. Strand Unravel spreading throughout entire packs and strand threadlings popping out left and right chasing down enemies and adding overall damage. 

All of this is obtained by firing off one single weapon and using our class ability. I add in my melee ability here and there for more Ignitions but it really is pretty simple once you understand what's going on. My other 2 weapons were just used for Anti Champion purposes. I wasn't even using an Exotic weapon like I mentioned earlier in any of the gameplay which is just crazy..

Your artifact choice is everything and I urge you guys to think outside the box. I really believe a ton of builds can be made like this on all 3 classes. But even if you can't come up with it yourself that's okay, That's what I am here for! I won't leave you guys hanging in the Finally of Destiny 2. 

For A solar Hunter you would think or lean too something like the Hunters Journal Artifact. With Mods in it like Solar Fulmination and Radiant Orbs to match your subclass. And that can be okay, but what Solar Hunter lacks is survivability the most. That's understandable because Solar Ignitions are so powerful when they go off. There is suppose to be some sort of trade off right? Well not anymore.

You might think the Queensfoil Censer Artifact with Solar is the play with mods like Rays of Precision to ignite enemies when you defeat them with precision shots and your radiant.

Well we through conventional thought process out the window and take the Tablet of Ruin Artifact which doesn't even have a Solar tag on it with what it works best with. We also don't even use a Fusion rifle, glaive or trac rifle.

This Artifact supplies all those powerful buffs and debuffs that we won't over earlier and it's all done in a very seamless way.

=== I have a PO Box because people asked for it ===
Paul is Bad At Stuff
PO BOX 2013, Southampton, SO15 9PY

I Tried Playing 40k Optimally for the First Time
I Went to a 40k Tournament with a Proper Army List
I Broke My Brain in the FIRST GAME at this 40k Tournament

I wanted to try playing 40k properly and attempt to end 10th edition by learning how to actually do not terribly so that in the future I can fully utilize my favourite chonky lads assuming centurions don't get sent to legends.

Yes, 11th edition is literally next week and will change everything and I'll have to relearn it. Yes this video took me 60 hours to make. Yes the first game is 20 minutes long. No I will not apologise. 

=== CHAPTERS ===
0:00 Introduction
1:09 My New Proper Screaming Ravens Army List (Shadowmark Talon Raven Guard)
4:03 Invictor Tactical Warsuits
4:47 I'm a huge loser (sponsor time)
5:38 Game 1 vs Aspect Host Aeldari
25:11 Game 2 vs Freeblade Company Imperial Knights
30:28 Game 3 vs War Horde Orks
32:05 Game 4 vs Retaliation Cadre T'au
35:48 Game 5 vs Rubricae Phalanx Thousand Sons (30 SOTS)
43:25 Ow my brain

Aethon Shaan (110pts): Warlord
Kayvaan Shrike (100pts)
Judiciar (95pts)
